Hidden In Plain Sight#002.src: You ask the raccoon about its day.
Hidden In Plain Sight#002.dst: Le preguntas al mapache qué tal le ha ido el día.

Hidden In Plain Sight#003.src: It opens its mouth as it gasps for air. Suddenly it stops and continues to run around anxiously... Interesting...
Hidden In Plain Sight#003.dst: Abre la boca, jadeando. De repente se detiene y vuelve a corretear, inquieto... Interesante...

Hidden In Plain Sight#005.src: Maybe you can gain its trust by feeding it.
Hidden In Plain Sight#005.dst: Quizá puedas ganarte su confianza dándole de comer.

Hidden In Plain Sight#006.src: Perhaps the nearby crop storages could help you.
Hidden In Plain Sight#006.dst: Quizá te sirvan los {c2}almacenes de cosechas{/} cercanos.

Hidden In Plain Sight#007.src: You meet eyes with the raccoon, it gapes at you with hunger.
Hidden In Plain Sight#007.dst: Cruzas la mirada con el mapache, que te observa boquiabierto de hambre.

Hidden In Plain Sight#008.src: Maybe you can help the raccoon. Look nearby, there could be some excess supplies.
Hidden In Plain Sight#008.dst: Quizá puedas ayudar al mapache. Busca por aquí cerca, puede que haya {c2}provisiones{/} de sobra.

Hidden In Plain Sight#009.src: You try scaring the raccoon, it doesn't seem to be affected... Weird...
Hidden In Plain Sight#009.dst: Intentas asustar al mapache, pero no parece afectarle... Qué raro...

Hidden In Plain Sight#011.src: The raccoon swiftly snatches the seeds from you!
Hidden In Plain Sight#011.dst: ¡El mapache te quita las semillas en un visto y no visto!

Hidden In Plain Sight#012.src: It's running somewhere! You should follow the raccoon.
Hidden In Plain Sight#012.dst: ¡Sale corriendo hacia algún sitio! Deberías seguir al {c2}mapache{/}.
